// The TypeScript declarations of the ServiceA service, generated by krpc-clientgen.
// The client builds the service at run time, so this module holds types only.
import type { RemoteService, ServiceB } from "@krpc-org/krpc";

/** A service whose procedures use another service's enumeration. */
export interface Service extends RemoteService {
  /** Defaults to a member of another service's enumeration. */
  frob(mode?: ServiceB.Mode): Promise<void>;
  frob(options: { mode?: ServiceB.Mode }): Promise<void>;
  /** Defaults to a collection containing a member of another service's enumeration. */
  frobAll(modes?: readonly ServiceB.Mode[]): Promise<void>;
  frobAll(options: { modes?: readonly ServiceB.Mode[] }): Promise<void>;
}
